rationale: Docker disk bloat causing production outages is a well-documented, recurring pain across DevOps communities — forum threads, Reddit posts, and GitHub issues consistently surface this as a class of incident rather than a one-off. Lightweight paid alternatives exist (Datadog, Grafana Cloud) at price points ($20–$200+/month) that confirm willingness to pay, though the segment's complaint is precisely that those tools are over-engineered and expensive for small teams. The specific ask ('track usage over time') implies product demand for continuous monitoring, not a one-time diagnostic.
